topics.label: Introduction to the Lecture
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture topic on the initiation and resolution of inflammation and outlines how previously learned immune concepts fit together.

topics.label: Innate Recognition via PAMPs, DAMPs, and Pattern Recognition Receptors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the innate immune system detects infection and tissue injury through conserved molecular patterns and pattern recognition receptor pathways.

topics.label: Sentinel Cell Signaling, Leukocyte Trafficking, and Inflammatory Responses
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail how activated immune cells orchestrate leukocyte migration and tissue-level responses to infection, as well as the risks of runaway systemic inflammation.

topics.label: Resolution of Inflammation, Tissue Repair, and Chronic Inflammation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the mechanisms that extinguish acute inflammatory responses, restore damaged tissues, and lead to sustained or controlled chronic inflammatory states.

topics.label: Conclusion and Next Lecture
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the presentation and previews the next lecture on the complement system.
